title: Kagamine Len — My Dancing Shoes!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, you're doing great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe! I've gotta keep up with Akito and Toya!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! How about this?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, Len. You seem to be in high spirits.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO! Did you come to watch?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, since I'm the one who said that you should try pursuing this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, how has juggling practice been going?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right! Akito, actually, brought a soccer ball for Len to use and began practicing with it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No problems there either! My record's up to 30 now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good for you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I didn't expect you to hit your stride this quickly, if I'm going to be honest. Maybe I should've come to check on you sooner.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Why?
Did you want to practice with me, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Not quite. I was hoping to see your progress in real time is all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My progress?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. For example, learning to do something you couldn't do the day before. I like seeing those kinds of eureka moments.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally get that!
It's an amazing feeling when whoever you're helping figures something out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That means you two might really like it if you learn about that other thing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What other thing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm actually thinking about trying something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The dance I'm practicing right now is the same as the one Akito and Toya are gonna do during the festival they're gonna be in...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm hoping to make a three-person version of it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I remember you mentioning something like that at MEIKO's place.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But the problem is that Akito and Toya are performing for real during the festival, so what I'm doing sort of feels like something extra, you know...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It does?
I'm sure they'll give both dances everything they have.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I know they will...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I sort of want them to focus more on their performance for the festival.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I want them to be able to help out Akito's friend in their time of need.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, that's why I've been thinking about making a version of this dance for three people.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But don't get me wrong. I'm giving it everything I have too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't worry. I know you will.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, have you thought about what kind of adjustments you'll be making...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I have a few ideas...
Wanna hear them?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I do! Tell us! Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, since you're here, some feedback might be nice too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was thinking about trying...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So today, I want you guys to hear my ideas about making a three-person version of your dance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. You even went through the trouble of asking Rin and KAITO for their feedback...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thanks, Len.
Let's hear it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was actually thinking about basing some moves on juggling a soccer ball!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Juggling a soccer ball?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't really do any fancy tricks, but you still have to use all sorts of different leg muscles, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But when people juggle a bunch of soccer balls at the same time, it kinda looks like they're break dancing, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I even heard that competitions for doing tricks like that exist! Freestyle football or something...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. That's true...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
That's why I thought it'd be cool to try something like that together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it could end up looking pretty cool as long as we fine-tune each step.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll bite.
This could be interesting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Rin and KAITO actually helped me choreograph some of it too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Someone came prepared.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course I did. Anyway, stand back and watch!
A few days after the Summer Festival

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, everyone ready?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup. Let's do this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.
song00009_off_s

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Weren't they amazing, An?!
They were good! Like really good!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Every other word you said just now is good, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I understand how you feel. The break dancing bit in the middle was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len actually came up with that part.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
He did?!
Len, that part was so good!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks. Rin and KAITO helped me come up with that, but Akito and Toya said they wanted to try it, so I felt really good about it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, you guys dancing at the Summer Festival was a pretty huge surprise too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys thinking about doing flash mobs and stuff now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No way. This was just a one-off thing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I think it'd be really cool to do something like this during one of our shows!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, you're grinning...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because I pulled off something really cool with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that it was a very good performance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too! I'm sure the wise old master is also satisfied with this result, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I barely had anything to do with this. Len did this all on his own.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I do also genuinely believe that it was a very good performance.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
Hehe. You should be proud of your star pupil!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. Star pupil...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks for doing this with me!
It turned out to be super fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We had fun too, right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we did. Let's try this again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!
